changes: (Fixed) 正式版默认连接本机 rekordbox 数据库；本机接口异常时显示错误，不再退回演示曲库。
(New) 导出前提示部分老款碟机的 FLAC、ALAC 及其他编码限制，可选择保持原格式或转换兼容副本为 WAV、AIFF、320 kbps MP3。
(Improved) 曲目、歌单与同步管理器均采用本次导出的格式选择；同步空间估算随选择更新，电脑原文件与保存的偏好设置保持不变。
(Fixed) 上下轨始终同步缩放：公共按钮及任一轨道滚轮同时缩放两轨，关闭联动或切换主轨也保持一致。
(Fixed) 双轨波形使用统一的播放时间比例，变速及半速、倍速匹配时保持一致的滚动速度。
(Improved) Sync 使用当前拍网时间戳和局部 BPM 对拍，修正首拍等待、变速拍网及短循环的相位计算。
(Improved) 持续 Sync 读取两轨当前拍网与精确播放速度，避免同时跨变速拍时使用旧 BPM；减少无关状态重算和重复速度参数设置。
(Fixed) BPM Sync 在 Quantize 开启时不再额外纠正播放位置；播放中按 Sync 使用引擎当前位置进行相对移动。
(Fixed) 导出小歌单时复用 U 盘已有音频和分析文件，仅复制新增曲目。
(Fixed) 保留已有 ANLZ0001、ANLZ0002 分析文件名及数据库引用。
(Fixed) 导出进度按后台实际处理总数显示，完成、取消和失败状态正确更新。
(Fixed) 导出结束或取消后刷新设备剩余空间。
(Fixed) 导出预览不再把保留的旧曲目计入待删除数量和可释放空间。
(Improved) 减少旧分析数据的重复复制，以及重复同步时对旧音频的多余读取。
(New) 导出前提示部分老款碟机的 FLAC、ALAC 及其他编码限制，可选择保持原格式或转换兼容副本为 WAV、AIFF、320 kbps MP3。
(Improved) 曲目、歌单与同步管理器均采用本次导出的格式选择；同步空间估算随选择更新，电脑原文件与保存的偏好设置保持不变。
(Fixed) 上下轨始终同步缩放：公共按钮及任一轨道滚轮同时缩放两轨，关闭联动或切换主轨也保持一致。
(Fixed) 双轨波形使用统一的播放时间比例，变速及半速、倍速匹配时保持一致的滚动速度。
(Improved) Sync 使用当前拍网时间戳和局部 BPM 对拍，修正首拍等待、变速拍网及短循环的相位计算。
(Improved) 持续 Sync 读取两轨当前拍网与精确播放速度，避免同时跨变速拍时使用旧 BPM；减少无关状态重算和重复速度参数设置。
(Fixed) BPM Sync 在 Quantize 开启时不再额外纠正播放位置；播放中按 Sync 使用引擎当前位置进行相对移动。
(Fixed) 导出小歌单时复用 U 盘已有音频和分析文件，仅复制新增曲目。
(Fixed) 保留已有 ANLZ0001、ANLZ0002 分析文件名及数据库引用。
(Fixed) 导出进度按后台实际处理总数显示，完成、取消和失败状态正确更新。
(Fixed) 导出结束或取消后刷新设备剩余空间。
(Fixed) 导出预览不再把保留的旧曲目计入待删除数量和可释放空间。
(Improved) 减少旧分析数据的重复复制，以及重复同步时对旧音频的多余读取。
(New) Edit a track’s Key directly in the track list by choosing from the library’s keys.
(Fixed) The first sync of a USB stick exported by rekordbox keeps tracks already on the stick instead of copying them again or requiring space for duplicate copies.
(Fixed) USB sync preserves tracks it did not export, even when their audio files are missing, and removes deselected tracks it did export once no device playlist or history needs them.
(Fixed) When a USB stick’s two libraries disagree, sync can update selected tracks and playlists; if another difference blocks the first sync, the message identifies what needs attention.
(Fixed) My Tags on exported tracks appear in compatible players’ Track Filter.
(Fixed) USB exports with accented names no longer use the database string layout that caused a CDJ-2000NXS to freeze.
(Fixed) MP3 playback, analysis, and WAV loop export follow rekordbox’s timeline so cues and beat grids line up with the audio.
(Fixed) Tracks opened from a USB stick in Devices show their artwork, waveforms, and beat grids.
(Fixed) USB export folders and playlists follow their order in the library tree.
(Fixed) A quick flick starts dragging a track on the first try, and editing a track no longer blanks and rebuilds the whole track list.
(Fixed) The beat-grid TAP button measures each tap when pressed, keeping the tapped tempo and beat position accurate.
(Fixed) XDJ-700 VBR uploads no longer interrupt browsing on a linked player.
(Improved) The Color column shows each track’s colour as a coloured circle beside its name.
(New) Add tracks already in a playlist again, choosing whether to skip or add duplicates and remembering your choice in Preferences.
(New) Import folders and large batches of tracks with progress, faster processing, and a Stop button.
(New) Confirmation questions now open in rbxport's own dialogs.
(Fixed) Export Playlist adds or updates the selected playlist without replacing the other playlists on the USB stick, while preserving empty folders and playlists kept from earlier exports.
(Fixed) A track that cannot be read, converted, or copied no longer stops the rest of a USB sync; Show details lists each track left out and why.
(Fixed) Save and delete cues made on linked CDJs and XDJs correctly, without stalling the player.
(Fixed) Linked players can load tracks stored directly on your computer, and repaired previews load correctly on compatible players.
(Fixed) Export tracks analysed during an active analysis run with their analysis files, and importing cues from a large USB no longer blocks analysis and sync for an extended time.
(Fixed) USB sync accepts a rekordbox stick's first sync and reads all playlist entries, including entries on larger export database pages.
(Fixed) RGB waveforms analysed by rbxport now match rekordbox's player height and colour.
(Fixed) Exporting AAC .m4a tracks with CDJ-compatible conversion no longer fails because of their channel layout.
(Fixed) Auto Relocate shows its Searching... status and waits correctly before analysis starts.
(Improved) USB resyncs finish faster by avoiding unnecessary rereads of every track.
(Improved) rbxport starts with less to load, while the device, Info, and confirmation panels load when first opened.
(Improved) Linux's window title and Sync Manager layout now fit the platform, without the unavailable iTunes column.
(New) Format a USB stick as FAT32 or HFS+ directly from its expanded row in Sync Manager.
(New) Preview the space a sync will add or free on each selected USB stick before it starts.
(New) Review every selected track with missing audio before syncing, then cancel or skip those tracks.
(New) Rename hot and memory cues, add cue comments from the colour menu, and drag hot cues into a new order.
(New) Create a new playlist exactly where you right-clicked.
(New) Remember your last Analyze Track choices.
(Fixed) Sync continues exporting the other tracks when one track's analysis files are missing.
(Fixed) Empty hot-cue rows no longer create a cue when clicked.
(Fixed) Sync Manager shows the underlying reason when a command fails.
(Fixed) Each mouse-wheel notch moves waveform zoom by exactly one level.
(Improved) Sync results now report tracks added, removed, and updated.
(Improved) Analysis preferences keep the first-beat memory-cue setting in one place and present their switches more clearly.
(New) Manage missing tracks in a Missing File Manager: find them, relocate them, or remove them from the collection.
(New) Browse and edit the playlists stored on a connected USB device from the Devices tree.
(New) Find rekordbox libraries on connected drives, choose the library drive, and respond when its drive is missing.
(New) Drop folders onto Playlists to create matching playlist folders and playlists.
(New) Edit metadata for several selected tracks together from the Information panel.
(New) List Collection tracks that have never been analysed.
(New) Show progress while importing rekordbox and iTunes XML files.
(New) Control loops live on both decks, including resizing them while they play.
(New) Add a memory cue on the first beat during analysis.
(Fixed) USB sync now handles drives touched by rekordbox, files newer than your computer clock, interrupted syncs, unplugged devices, and background-agent leftovers more safely.
(Fixed) Export to exFAT and older-Mac FAT32 sticks, including tracks with accented names.
(Fixed) Avoid copying music that is already on the USB device and preserve deselected tracks during later syncs.
(Fixed) XML re-import now asks before replacing same-named playlists and replaces their tracks together without partial writes.
(Fixed) Relocate all matching missing tracks from the Missing File Manager and follow rekordbox's search folders and file chooser.
(Fixed) Preview playback stops when another playlist or deck takes over and follows the master volume.
(Fixed) Quantized hot-cue jumps wait for the beat and leave loops correctly; short loops and loop-length stepping now match rekordbox.
(Fixed) BPM SYNC starts on the master's beat after loading or restarting, and CUE or PLAY can cancel a pending move.
(Fixed) Delete removes every selected track once and asks before removing tracks from playlists, history, or the Tag List.
(Fixed) Import track tags, cues, and history correctly when files or tracks are not already in the library.
(Fixed) Cloud-synced tracks play and reload tags from their local copy.
(Fixed) Long tracks draw their waveform and beat grid to the end.
(Fixed) Beat-grid tempo edits continue to work after tempo changes, and grid shifts are audible immediately.
(Fixed) Maximum CDJ compatibility also converts low-sample-rate MP3s.
(Fixed) Export a playlist directly to a connected USB device instead of opening a folder picker.
(Fixed) Keep USB playlist edits consistent by blocking them while the device is busy and preserving the right track and playlist state.
(Improved) Browser column dragging shows where a column will land, and column changes persist across restarts.
(Improved) USB sync reports the specific failure when an export cannot finish.
(Improved) Device playlist edits and USB import results use the interface's selected language.
(New) Remember the DUAL control across restarts.
(New) Add keyboard bindings for hot cues D-H and all hot cue clears.
(New) Preview a track by clicking its waveform in the browser.
(New) Add AIFF export conversion.
(New) Add Keyboard pane rows for per-deck low/mid/high EQ kill.
(New) Hide the missing-file manager from users for now.
(New) Tell reporters their bug description is posted publicly.
(New) Show reporters a link to follow their bug report.
(New) Import every identified column from rekordbox's browser layout.
(New) Sort tracks by every column rekordbox can sort.
(Fixed) Match rekordbox's Explorer track menu for imported and loose files.
(Fixed) Base the track menu in the Explorer on each file's import state.
(Fixed) Name the refused file handle in stale-handle log lines.
(Fixed) Match rekordbox's BPM + KEY related tracks, half and double tempo included.
(Fixed) Analyse every selected track, not only those in the row cache.
(Fixed) Show the Backups preferences fully in the chosen language.
(Fixed) Let Windows backups flush the database copy.
(Fixed) Add files already in the library to the playlist they are dropped on.
(Fixed) Let beat-grid edits confirm tempo changes on macOS and start at zero.
(Fixed) Answer intelligent playlists on a My Tag.
(Fixed) Apply Browse font size and line space to the playlist tree.
(Fixed) Let mouse wheel notches always step the waveform zoom.
(Fixed) Slow trackpad waveform zoom and make the sidebar easier to resize.
(Fixed) Install Windows updates silently at quit.
(Fixed) Sort tracks by DJ play count.
(Fixed) Use hidden Pioneer root on HFS exports.
(Fixed) Register analysis for rekordbox waveforms.
(Fixed) Localize the native menu at runtime.
(Fixed) Recognize Linux FAT32 sync devices.
(Fixed) Include intelligent playlists in Sync Manager.
(New) Warn before unlocking an unbacked library.
(New) Include complete context in bug reports.
(Fixed) Default automatic analysis to off.
(Fixed) Preserve active loop ends on export.
(Fixed) Tolerate malformed library text.
(New) rbxport 1.0 is now available.
(Fixed) Preserve audio extensions on FAT exports.
(New) Recognize the paired PRO DJ LINK identities used by compatible all-in-one players.
(Fixed) Files and folders dropped onto a playlist import correctly on Linux.
(Fixed) Smart Playlists load more reliably from rekordbox XML and match relative-date, text, and numeric rules correctly.
(Fixed) LINK key labels and key sorting now follow their separate player settings consistently.
(Improved) Automatic LINK connections prefer wired adapters and keep player membership and addresses current as devices reconnect or leave the network.
(Improved) LINK Export file transfers use more player-compatible request sizes and responses, reducing unnecessary network retransmissions during track loads.
(Improved) LINK browsing and player control handle unsupported requests, load responses, and rejected connections more reliably.
(New) Automatically connect to available PRO DJ LINK players and mixers with an opt-in setting.
(New) USB sync warns when a device is not formatted as FAT32.
(New) Support rbxport with a donation button in the main window.
(Fixed) RBX-25: Playlist positions remain correct when sorting or filtering. Dropping files onto a playlist now shows import progress immediately.
(Fixed) RBX-24: Album artwork keeps its original colors in the info panel.
(Fixed) RBX-23: Create playlists and folders in an empty library or after deleting the last playlist.
(Fixed) Smart Playlists work in LINK Export, with corrected text and numeric rule matching.
(Fixed) LINK browsing uses the player's supported categories, preserves playlist hierarchy order, and handles menu pagination correctly.
(Fixed) XDJ-RX3 browse rows show the active sort column and configured key notation, while preserving key-matching information.
(Fixed) LINK history shows the active session and records tracks when the player reports them as played.
(Fixed) Track titles display correctly for legacy LINK clients.
(Fixed) USB sync refreshes available destinations before starting and repairs legacy analysis files during export.
(Improved) LINK library services use the selected network interface.
(Improved) LINK preview reads use a bounded cache and combine adjacent requests.
(Improved) Mixer cue indicators and PRO DJ LINK settings use a more consistent layout.
(Improved) Linux uses native window decorations.
(New) Import selected iTunes playlists into your library from the Sync Manager.
(New) The status bar shows a prompt when an update is ready to install.
(New) Open rbxport's TikTok from a link in the About pane.
(New) rbxport reports crashes automatically so failures can be diagnosed and fixed.
(New) Use LINK with the XDJ-RX3 over rear USB and correctly handle all-in-one players whose decks and mixer share one network address.
(Improved) Browsing a player's menus over LINK a second time is instant, as the menus are now cached.
(Improved) LINK browsing, sorting, and export compatibility with the XDJ-RX3 are more complete.
(Fixed) Key analysis now saves its result in new and sparsely imported libraries.
(Fixed) USB sync on macOS no longer reports a completed export as failed when an exFAT device does not support directory flushing.
(Fixed) On Linux, USB drives are detected reliably and diagnostics report the app's thread count.
(New) Import selected iTunes playlists into your library from the Sync Manager.
(New) The status bar shows a prompt when an update is ready to install.
(New) Open rbxport's TikTok from a link in the About pane.
(New) rbxport reports crashes automatically so failures can be diagnosed and fixed.
(Improved) Browsing a player's menus over LINK a second time is instant, as the menus are now cached.
(New) Use LINK with the XDJ-RX3 over rear USB and correctly handle all-in-one players whose decks and mixer share one network address.
(Fixed) USB sync on macOS no longer reports a completed export as failed when an exFAT device does not support directory flushing.
(New) Import cues and beat grids, play history, and CDJ/mixer settings from USB devices with one Import button in the Sync Manager, and choose which are ticked when it opens.
(Fixed) Over LINK, a player's HISTORY shows this session's LINK HISTORY, as with rekordbox, and tracks played on the decks are recorded to it.
(Fixed) Adding a track to the Tag List, from the menu or a player, no longer reloads the list on screen.
(Fixed) Recently added text is translated, and several mistranslated labels are corrected.
(Fixed) Rating stars are the same size on macOS, Windows and Linux.
(Fixed) Scrolling the waveform zoom quickly on linked decks moves through every zoom step instead of skipping some.
(Fixed) Open and closed folders in the library tree are remembered across restarts.
(Fixed) On macOS, rbxport asks for access when library music is on a network volume.
(New) Undo and redo playlist renames, moves, deletions and track removals, plus track metadata, rating, comment, colour and My Tag edits.
(New) See release notes before updating and get a persistent prompt when a downloaded update is ready to install.
(Improved) Each deck's waveform zoom is remembered across sessions.
(Improved) Scrubbing opens to full-frequency audio at normal playback speed.
(Fixed) A playing deck immediately plays the next loaded track, even when tracks are switched rapidly.
(Fixed) The inline BPM editor stays the same compact width as its readout.
(Fixed) Switching to a shorter playlist no longer leaves old track rows painted below the list.
(Fixed) USB waveform settings such as RGB can be changed while rekordbox is running; the status badge now clarifies that only library editing is read-only.
(Fixed) Hot cues without a custom colour use the default green instead of appearing black.
(New) Control rbxport from AppleScript on macOS.
(New) Undo and redo deleting playlists and folders from the Edit menu.
(New) Create a rekordbox library when none exists instead of opening an empty window with an error.
(New) Keep the last library screen, artwork, and waveforms visible while the library loads.
(New) Right-click the version in the status bar to open the current application log.
(Improved) USB devices and Sync Manager load faster on macOS, and Preferences and bug reporting open faster on every platform.
(Fixed) Bug reports can be sent again on macOS and Windows.
(Fixed) Track artwork appears correctly on Windows.
(Fixed) Zoomed waveforms line up with the playhead and beat grid on tracks with encoder delay.
(Fixed) Sub-browser track actions, reordering, and Information now act on the playlist open on the right.
